name: MKX Disposable | Sundae Driver (Limited Edition)
description:
Get 2x the flavor & power with our 2-Gram Disposable, now featuring a new physical button for function activation and LED Battery Life Indication! Enjoy longer sessions, richer terpene profiles, and consistent, smooth hits backed by premium hardware. Portable, reliable, and flavorful—our improved 2G Disposables deliver a premium, hassle free experience anytime, anywhere.

Instructions:

Press 1X—Check Battery Life

Press 2X—Preheat Mode

Press 5X—Turn On/Off

Inhale Activated

Battery Life:

1 Light: -25%

2 Lights: 25-50%

3 Lights: 50-70%

4 Lights: 70-100%
